programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed

programme.title: Close Encounters Down Under

programme.title: Close Encounters Down Under

programme.title: Zola
programme.desc: (2020) Dark comedy drama based on a viral Twitter thread. Dancer Zola (Taylour Paige) joins a road trip to Tampa, where she gets dragged too far into the sex work world. Adults only.

programme.title: Fixed Bayonets!
programme.desc: (1951) Korean War drama about the stress of battle. Officers drop one by one as a US platoon fights a rearguard action, leaving one unwilling man (Richard Basehart) to take their place.

programme.title: Sword of Sherwood Forest
programme.desc: (1960) Adventure with Richard Greene, Peter Cushing and a young Oliver Reed. Can Robin Hood foil the villainous Sheriff of Nottingham's evil plan to murder the Archbishop of Canterbury?

programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: (1976) Touching romance starring Sean Connery and Audrey Hepburn. The ageing legend Robin Hood returns to Sherwood Forest and discovers that, while he was away, Marian has become an Abbess.

programme.title: Turner & Hooch
programme.desc: (1989) Comedy-thriller starring Tom Hanks. A cop investigates a murder to which there's just one witness: Hooch, a slobbering, beer-drinking French mastiff, who now needs 24/7 protection.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: (2019) Will Smith stars in Ang Lee's action-thriller as both an over-the-hill hitman and the young clone of himself sent to take him out. With Clive Owen.

programme.title: White House Down
programme.desc: (2013) All-American action thriller starring Channing Tatum and Jamie Foxx. A Capitol police officer steps up to protect the President when the White House is compromised.

programme.title: The Dive
programme.desc: (2023) Maximilian Erlenwein's breath-holding underwater survival thriller about two sisters on a fateful diving expedition, starring Louisa Kause and Sophie Lowe.

programme.title: Anaïs in Love
programme.desc: (2021) Romcom with Anaïs Demoustier. A young woman can't seem to stay still or move on, as she seeks satisfaction through a variety of complicated relationships. Sex/nudity. In French/subs.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan
programme.desc: We travel to Miyagi and Yamagata, where nature is most colourful in early summer. We taste shijimi clams and bamboo shoots, and encounter the mysterious scenery of submerged forest in a lake.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Japanese Armour: Beauty in Defence
programme.desc: Iconic Japanese armour worn for defence - 16th-century helmets featured outlandish shapes like a giant crescent moon or the ears of a rabbit. We uncover the spirit of the samurai behind its creation.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Daniel Moore takes a cinematic journey through Nagano - he hits the south in springtime to experience the breathtaking cherry blossoms and gets lost in magical winter landscapes up north.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: First Childbirth: In the Edo period, childbirth was a community affair with the mother-to-be attended by a midwife and the women in her life - it was also characterised by unique customs and beliefs.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Japan has a long history of natural disasters - 'Bosai' explores how to overcome them and save lives with the power of science.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Yamagata / Nakui Naoko (book designer) Thread for traditional 'shina' fabric takes a year to make. Ultrafine mohair is also made here with a 60-year-old device. Nakui admires the hunt for improvement.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Highlights
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan presents a sumo highlights programme for fans around the globe. Today the show features all top-division bouts from July 18, Day 7 of the Grand Sumo Tournament in Nagoya.

programme.title: Sumopedia
programme.desc: Sumopedia enriches your sumo experience with information on the techniques, traditions and famous wrestlers of the past - the rules may be simple, but there is a lot more to sumo than meets the eye...

programme.title: Documentary 360
programme.desc: The Copper Belt in south central Africa is home to vast unexplored copper reserves. The US, China and Japan are vying to establish presences there to secure this critical industrial resource.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Manben: Behind the Scenes of Manga
programme.desc: Check out manga artist Oshimi Shuzo, whose trauma-probing stories have led to many screen adaptations. Learn how manga can be self-therapy as he works on Blood on the Tracks.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: J-Melo
programme.desc: Experience the cutting edge of Japanese entertainment as we turn the spotlight on virtual artists - this time, HIMEHINA, a female duo with over 600 million video views.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: An animated series about a Japanese dog who gets lost in New York City. Charo says 'I want to see my owner again!', and so he starts his adventure to find his way back home. (S1, E16)

programme.title: Japanology Plus mini
programme.desc: End-of-life planning is spreading in Japan - some people are planning ahead and choosing low-cost shared graves over family graves, and some cities are offering end-of-life planning support.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View of Japan
programme.desc: Mama cat Koyuki lives at a pottery workshop and is raising two playful kittens - Taisho, who lives at a fruit shop, keeps an eye on the shopping arcade. Both cats love resting on their owner's laps!

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Anime Manga Explosion
programme.desc: Anime Manga Explosion features major Japanese anime and manga works that are highly recognised by international fans. Each episode explores the secrets of the works' popularity.

programme.title: The Wakey Show
programme.desc: This episode features 'Wakey's Door' on paints, a Comedy Writers skit, 'Pretending to be Asleep,' and a long version of the theme song, 'That's Good Too!' It energizes kids.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The World Heritage Sites in Japan
programme.desc: A selection of acclaimed programmes from NHK's domestic channels dubbed into English.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato

programme.desc: Spain v Argentina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the final, which takes place at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Argentina are aiming to become only the third nation in history to win back-to-back world crowns, following on from Italy in the 1930s, and Brazil in 1958 and 1962, but will need to be at their very best against the Spaniards. They won on their only other appearance in the final, against the Netherlands in 2010, and start as favourites against the defending champions. programme.title: Payday
programme.desc: 1973. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars Rip Torn, Ahna Capri & Elayne Heilveil. Maury Dann, a not-so-nice country-western singer, ruthlessly manipulates everyone around him to suit his selfish needs.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1996. Tonight, Britain's biggest adult actress, Sarah Young, is interviewed in the studio and get to know the 70 year old couple who won the French pig imitation championships.

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Tonight, find out how a chimp might help treat baldness, defy gravity with floating frogs and are paranormal powers at play at your local football ground?

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Secret. 1959. Starring: John Newland, Maria Palmer & Robert Douglas. A young woman is left alone with her domineering husband. She soon invents an imaginary lover who loves and comforts her.

programme.title: Fritz the Cat
programme.desc: Director: Ralph Bakshi. Stars Skip Hinnant, Rosetta LeNoire & John McCurry. A pretentious, womanizing young cat drops out of college and finds himself caught in all kinds of illegal business.

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Jack the Ripper. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Niall MacGinnis & Dorothy Alison. A troubled clairvoyant dreams of Jack the Ripper's killings and assists the police.

programme.title: Mickey One
programme.desc: 1965. Crime. Directed by Arthur Penn. Stars Warren Beatty, Alexandra Stewart & Hurd Hatfield. A stand-up comic incurs the wrath of the Mafia and escapes to Chicago but yearns to go back on stage.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Italian saxophonist Riccardo Rauchi and his ensemble of musicians perform Okay Madison.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Thieves. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. It's difficult to find employment if branded a thief. Lancelot gets the King to don a disguise and enter a den of thieves.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Like Visions and Omens and All That Jazz. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. A psychic predicts several murder attempts on an heiress.

programme.title: A Tale of Five Cities
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Stars Bonar Colleano, Barbara Kelly, Eva Bartok & Gina Lollobrigida. An Englishman leaves America to enlist in the RAF, but a drunken accident results in a loss of memory.

programme.title: Fate Takes a Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Ronald Howard, Christina Gregg, Basil Dignam. Letters recovered from a stolen mail bag significantly impact the lives of the recipients 15 years later.

programme.title: The Drum
programme.desc: 1938. War. Directed by Zoltan Korda. Stars Sabu, Raymond Massey & Roger Livesey. When the Khan of Tokot is murdered, his killer, the evil Prince Ghul, plots an uprising against British rule.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Bloody Tower. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Glynis Johns. Batman saves Robin & Batgirl. Robin is stung by a Death Bee. Lord Ffogg & Lady Peasoup prepare to steal the crown jewels.

programme.title: For Those In Peril
programme.desc: 1944. War Drama. Director: Charles Crichton. Stars David Farrar, Ralph Michael & Robert Wyndham. A WWII flyer fails to join the RAF so he joins the Air - Sea Rescue instead.

programme.title: Pollyanna
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Amanda Burton, Tom Bell & Kenneth Cranham. Young orphan Pollyanna, bringing mirth and mayhem to her new home, goes to stay with her Aunt Polly.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: 77 Bus. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Robert Cawdron & Ivan Craig. Police are baffled by robberies known as 'the Red Rose series'; Maguire and his partner suspect a seemingly innocent jeweller.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Another Man. 1970. Stars Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Walter's refusal to go dancing at the Over 60s Club and acceptance of overcooked pies from other women annoys Ada. (S1, E05)

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: Alexander the Great Affair: Part One. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. A mysterious U.S. industrialist, Mr. Alexander, steals a new type of nerve gas from the U.S. Army.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Take a trip in the past lane with a nostalgic cycling proficiency film featuring a young Roy Hudd, a lost training film starring John Cleese & Adrienne Posta, & a reminisce on teatime traditions.

programme.title: The Winslow Boy
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Anthony Asquith. Stars Robert Donat, Cedric Hardwicke & Basil Radford. Pre-WWI England, a youngster is expelled from a naval academy for theft. His parents demand a trial.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Game of Murder
programme.desc: 1966. Stars Gerald Harper, Conrad Phillips & David Burke. When a former athlete's mysterious death seems suspicious, his detective son investigates.

programme.title: Horror of Frankenstein
programme.desc: 1971. Horror. Directed by Jimmy Sangster. Stars Dennis Price, Kate O'Mara & Ralph Bates. Young Victor Frankenstein inherits his father's title, his castle and his taste for grisly experiments.

programme.title: Night of the Big Heat
programme.desc: 1967. Sci-Fi. Directed by Terence Fisher. Starring Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing & Patrick Allen. A heatwave forces the atmosphere to boil. It falls on Godfrey Hanson to discover the reason.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Where Has Poor Mickey Gone?
programme.desc: Unseen for years this strange, B-Picture oddity sees Warren Mitchell superb as fairground magician Emilio Dinelli, tormented by a gang of rowdies who take him prisoner in his backstreet workshop.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Pigeons Of Paris. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Wanderer. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Karel Stepanek. En route to Nottingham to treat Sir Walter, Robin meets a healer whose treatments draw attention from other doctors.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Prize of Andalusia. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Jean Cadell & Conrad Phillips. The charming Marquesa of Andalusia schemes to steal gold. Tempest comes up against her tricks in an attempt to stop her.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Rescue. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On its maiden flight, Supercar, piloted by Mike Mercury, is sent to rescue brothers Bill and Jimmy Gibson who are adrift at sea.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Gamblers. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Martin Benson & Thea Gregory. June Belmont is invited by Carlos Rodrigues to join the roulette table. June brings Carlos some luck so they become partners.

programme.title: Three Sundays to Live
programme.desc: 1957. Mystery. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars Kieron Moore, Jane Griffiths & Basil Dignam. Frank Martin is accused of murder and the only woman who can prove his innocence is missing.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: 1960. Crime. Directed by Don Sharp. Stars Andrew Faulds, Stratford Johns & William Lucas. A renowned safecracker and his men attempt to rob a bank by entering the vault through the sewer system.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the end of July and beginning of August.

programme.title: British Intelligence
programme.desc: 1940. War. Director: Terry Morse. Stars Boris Karloff, Margaret Lindsay, Bruce Lester & Leonard Mudie. Bennett's home is a hotbed for spies. But no one knows the identity of the German spymaster.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Pastime. 1974. Stars John Slater, Malcolm Terris & Angela Crow. A fireraiser for Detective Skinner and an extortionist for Stone and Lynch. Some people have the strangest pastimes.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Returning
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Roy Kellino. Stars Dick Powell & Joan Elan. A professor in Japan is fired after falling for a former student. He is determined to bring her to the US.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: With Love from Adolf. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Iain Cuthbertson. Are Ash's injuries too much to overcome - or is it depression over the many lives lost?

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Lord of Kerak. 1962. Stars Dermot Walsh, Willoughby Goddard & Nadja Regin. When Lord Arnold hears that the King is travelling to query his absence from battle, he plans to have Richard killed.

programme.title: The Flemish Farm
programme.desc: 1943. War. Directed by Jeffery Dell. Stars Jane Baxter, Clifford Evans, Philip Friend. Based on a true story. A Belgian Pilot's daring attempt to retrieve the Colours from Nazi-occupied Belgium.

programme.title: Look At Life Student Nurse
programme.desc: 1959. Following the reflections of a student nurse over her three years of training.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by Henry Cass. Stars Alec Guinness, Beatrice Campbell & Kay Walsh. A salesman who learns he has months to live cashes in his savings to live in a fancy hotel.

programme.title: 1950s Celebrity Tea Party
programme.desc: From the private collection of Richard Hearne. Lovely footage a of charity celebrity Tea Party with Vera Lynn as the star guest. See who you can spot among the celebrity guests?

programme.title: Tawny Pipit
programme.desc: 1944. Drama. Directed by Bernard Miles and Charles Saunders. Starring Bernard Miles, Rosamund John and Niall MacGinnis. A village bands together to save its wildlife from road development.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week's blast from the past incudes a reel from 1953's Coronation Fair, a sneak into the secret Cabaret Club & we go offshore to remember Radio North Sea International.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Man on the Bench. 1993. Stars Bruno Cremer, Marie Dubois & Andréa Ferréol. Louis Thouret is found stabbed to death. Maigret uncovers a trail of the victim's secrets while hunting the killer.

programme.title: So Evil, So Young
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jill Ireland, Ellen Pollock & John Charlesworth. Framed for robbery and sent to a reform school, a young girl becomes the target of a vicious warden.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Marie Walters Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert Karnes & Barbara Stuart. Detective Ruditsky solves the murder of a young woman by uncovering crucial evidence.

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Sarlat - Meurtres à Sarlat. 2017. Director: Delphine Lemoine. Stars Cecile Bois & Thierry Godard. The son of the region's largest manufacturer of preserved foods has been murdered.

programme.title: Melody
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Directed by Waris Hussein. Stars Mark Lester, Tracy Hyde & Jack Wild. Two youngsters declare to their parents they want to get married as soon as possible.

programme.title: It Happened Today
programme.desc: Made in 1947. A Road safety film by the West Riding Constabulary. Narrated by Patrick Holt.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. An Eerie, Airy, Thing. Crime series produced by Aaron Spelling. Starring Anne Francis. A distraught man wants to see his wife before he dies of suicide.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Laughing Lady Of Luxor. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen.

programme.title: Cottage to Let
programme.desc: 1941. War. Director: Anthony Asquith. Stars Leslie Banks, Alastair Sim & John Mills. Nazi spies learn about a new device created by a British inventor and send an undercover agent to his cottage.

programme.title: Doublecross
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director Anthony Squire. Stars Donald Houston, Fay Compton, William Hartnell. A Cornish poacher clashes with dangerous international spies.

programme.title: Sea to Plate and Billingsgate
programme.desc: 1956. Documentary on the distribution of fish throughout England. From tower bridge at 6am at Billingsgate in the 1950s to all the little harbours around the coast and everything in between.

programme.title: Doctor at Sea
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Brigitte Bardot, James Robertson. A young man signs up to be a ship's doctor in an effort to bring some excitement into his life.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Wallet
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars Charles Boyer & Maria Palmer. A waiter with more pride than money takes a wealthy customer's forgotten wallet to get his sick wife good medical care.

programme.title: Railway Murders
